convertibility_reason: Uses custom indicator RSIOMA via iCustom() which is not a built-in MT5 indicator. The RSIOMA indicator itself is derived from RSI of MA, requiring the custom .ex5 indicator file to be present. Entry/exit logic is moderately complex with multi-level signal interpretation.

other_exits: Closes long on short signal and vice versa (signal reversal exit)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative Lots value = fixed lot size (absolute value used). Positive Lots value = fraction of deposit (margin-based sizing). Zero = minimum lot.

custom_logic_notes: RSIOMA is a custom indicator that calculates RSI applied to a Moving Average rather than raw price. The EA uses two buffers from RSIOMA: buffer 0 (main RSIOMA line) and buffer 1 (signal line). Entry uses crossover of these lines. RSIOMA levels at 80 (overbought) and 20 (oversold) zones are used as additional confirmation/filter. The EA processes signals only on new bars (IsNewBar guard). SL/TP values are adjusted for 5-digit brokers by multiplying by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001.
external_dependencies: RSIOMA.ex5 (custom indicator required in Indicators folder)
python_conversion_notes: The RSIOMA custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python: first compute EMA of close prices, then compute RSI of that EMA series. The signal line is a further MA applied to the RSIOMA values. Entry logic is standard crossover on previous bar values ([1] indices). SL/TP digit adjustment logic must be replicated: if price has 5+ digits, multiply pip values by 10. Position sizing has dual-mode: negative input = fixed lots, positive = deposit fraction via margin calculation. The new-bar guard must be implemented to prevent multiple signals per bar.
